excerpt.zh:
我们的克隆设施运转效率远超最初预期，导致现在出现了克隆体过剩的情况。

整合如此多的工蜂将是一个挑战。
excerpt.en:
Our cloning facilities are operating more efficiently than we initially expected, so we now have a clone surplus.

Integrating this many drones is proving challenging.
